# Lyrimuse

> Real-time, word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou — and YouTube Music or Spotify Web playing in any browser — on macOS, plus a Last.fm listening profile and on-device translation.

Lyrimuse is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) macOS menu-bar app. It shows word-by-word synced lyrics in a floating overlay, a Dynamic-Island-style capsule, a full Apple-Music-style lyrics window, or the menu bar itself, for any combination of players you select (or let it auto-detect) — including YouTube Music and Spotify Web running in a browser, synced to the page's own progress. Lyrics are resolved from eight sources (NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo, Musixmatch, LRCLIB, LyricFind via YouTube Music, AMLL), with on-device machine translation and per-line romanization (pinyin, Cantonese Jyutping, Japanese furigana). The UI is available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Once connected, it also shows a Last.fm listening profile (totals, charts, listening footprint) and a local listening history that backfills to Last.fm/ListenBrainz once you connect. It ships ad-hoc signed; no Apple Developer account is needed to build, distribute, or install it.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/README.md): full feature list, installation options (Homebrew, manual download, build from source), FAQ, troubleshooting
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 中文版功能列表、安装方式、常见问题、排查
- [README (繁體中文)](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/README.zh-Hant.md): 繁體中文版功能列表、安裝方式、常見問題、疑難排解
- [Feature specification index](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/docs/features/README.md): as-built spec, 15 chapters covering every feature's current behavior, edge cases, and code anchors
- [How scrobbling works](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/docs/scrobbling.md): exactly what gets submitted to Last.fm/ListenBrainz and when ([中文版](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/docs/scrobbling.zh-CN.md))
- [Comparison with LyricsX, Lyric Fever and Lyrics Plus](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/docs/lyrics-apps-comparison.md): fact-checked feature/requirements table and honest routing between the four apps ([中文版](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/docs/lyrics-apps-comparison.zh-CN.md))
- [Releases](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/releases): per-version changelogs and downloadable builds (Apple Silicon and Intel)

## Code

- [lyrimuse/](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/tree/main/lyrimuse): the macOS app (Swift, SwiftUI + AppKit)
- [lyrimuse-collector/](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/tree/main/lyrimuse-collector): the background engine that resolves lyrics and artwork (Go), bundled into the app automatically

## Related projects

- [nowplaying](https://github.com/Yudaotor/nowplaying): the optional shareable "now playing" web page, plus a fork-ready template
- [nowplaying-workers](https://github.com/Yudaotor/nowplaying-workers): the Cloudflare Worker relay behind that web page, with a from-scratch setup guide
